svg.title: The Stackz starter layout as a tree of stacks
svg.desc: The full screen (W) splits into the left two columns (H) and the remaining five (semicolon). H splits into top-left (Y) and bottom-left (N). Semicolon splits into the center (J) and right (K) columns. J splits into center-bottom (M) and center-top (U); K into right-top (I) and right-bottom (comma). Solid lines mark main branches, dashed lines minor ones.
svg.text: The starter layout, as a tree
Every stack splits in two. Send a window into a stack below one that is in use, and the window up there slides into the other branch.
The root is send-only; every other stack also has Swap, Select and Spin.
